name: Jaroah
title: Gadite Patriarch
summary: Jaroah was a descendant of the tribe of Gad and is mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Gilead and the father of Huri, belonging to one of the Gadite families that lived in the region of Bashan. He is part of the genealogical records kept during the reigns of Jotham and Jeroboam.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Gad
keyEvents.description: Jaroah is listed as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Gad in 1 Chronicles, as the son of Gilead and the father of Huri.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Gad in Bashan
keyEvents.description: Jaroah's clan lived in Gilead and the Bashan region, which was allotted to the tribe of Gad east of the Jordan.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy during Jotham and Jeroboam
keyEvents.description: The genealogy that includes Jaroah was recorded during the days of Jotham, king of Judah, and Jeroboam II, king of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Settlements of the Gadites
keyEvents.description: Jaroah's family and clan were among the Gadite clans who had their settlements in Gilead, Bashan, its towns, and all the pasturelands of Sharon.
